about: Prior-lane hardware-validated numbers that the recorded evidence in this checkout cannot re-derive directly. They are merged into the baseline with grade V (documented) and are NOT presented as raw measurements of this lane. Every entry names its source.

entries.title: hostapd launch -> 'wlan0: AP-ENABLED' (open config, 2.4 GHz ch6)
entries.method: documented: lead lane brief 2026-11-27 ('hostapd startup ~2 s'); the live perf_probe/watch mode measures it exactly
entries.source: lead lane brief 2026-11-27 (project STATE); wifi-ap-start/HOSTAPD-BRINGUP.md sec 12
entries.detail: approximate (~2 s); not re-measured in this lane

entries.title: hostapd processes alive after AP-ENABLED
entries.method: documented: wifi-ap-start/REPORT.md (persistent AP check)
entries.detail: 5 processes reported at the persistence check (2026-11-27 09:00); 4 at the fire

entries.title: 13-channel scan: channels covered before the host window expired (prior fire)
entries.method: documented: prior-lane fire report; the raw UART record in this checkout has a 6/13 fire at the same 14.7 s window (variance recorded)
entries.detail: 12 BSS parsed, 4/13 channels in the 14,700 ms window (~3.5 s/channel effective)

entries.title: 13-channel scan: BSS entries decoded in the prior fire
entries.method: documented: prior-lane fire report
entries.detail: first full BSS decode on the clean-room stack

entries.title: auto scan window formula: base
entries.method: documented: source constant in wifi-scan-complete/hi5622_scan_logic.c (scan_timeout_ms=0 -> auto)
entries.detail: auto window = clamp(3000 + n_channels*900, 1000, 45000) ms

entries.title: auto scan window formula: per-channel term
entries.method: documented: source constant in wifi-scan-complete/hi5622_scan_logic.c
entries.detail: matches the ~830 ms/channel estimate from the 6-result/5 s fire, NOT the later ~3.5 s/channel fire

entries.title: auto scan window formula: clamp maximum
entries.method: documented: source constant in wifi-scan-complete/hi5622_scan_logic.c
entries.detail: 13-channel auto a=14700 ms; manual scan_timeout_ms is clamped to 45000 ms

entries.title: H2D announce-consumption poll period
entries.method: documented: driver source constant HI5622_H2D_POLL_MS=5 (h2d_send.c); also the recorded max_polls unit
entries.detail: 'consumed after 0 polls' therefore means <5 ms, not 0 ms

entries.title: bench policy frame gap between H2D frames (allow_frames ladder)
entries.method: documented: bench-session module params frame_gap_ms=100; driver default is 20 ms
entries.detail: 100 ms x 6 cfg_cal = ~0.5 s of the C2 phase; production default is 20 ms

entries.title: D2H direct-reader service thread cadence (hcc_poll_ms default)
entries.method: documented: driver module param hcc_poll_ms default 5 (service.c); one thread per PCI endpoint
entries.detail: two endpoints => two service threads at up to 200 wakeups/s each; the console print cost is what actually stretches the cadence

entries.title: HCC heartbeat watchdog (vendor hrtimer restarted by g4 id4)
entries.method: documented: hcc_core.h HCC_HEARTBEAT_MS=10000 (vendor RE)
entries.detail: the device sends g4 id4 about once per second; the watchdog is 10 s

entries.title: Wi-Fi interrupts used by the driver (polled design)
entries.method: documented + dmesg: 'no MSI/INTx routing documented; enumerating without interrupts'; the direct reader polls
entries.source: dmesg boot lines (UART/session evidence) + wifi-d2h-direct lane
entries.detail: the whole receive path is poll-driven; there is no IRQ to wake the host

entries.title: TX frame completion_pending after a publish (1 = POST-ONLY, device rptr not advanced)
entries.method: documented: combined AP+DP fire; the recorded E1 session evidence only covers dp_setup + TXQ sync, not a TX publish
entries.detail: wptr 0->1, table wptr=1 rptr=0, completion_pending=1, magic_processed=0

entries.title: RX frames captured by dp_rx_poll after the POST-ONLY publish
entries.method: documented: combined AP+DP fire
entries.detail: the MAC consumer does not advance rptr; RX is not reached

entries.title: CPU busy during normal AP operation (live 1 s /proc/stat sample)
entries.method: documented: live tuning-phase bench sample; user+sys unchanged and idle +200/200 jiffies over a 1 s sample (2 CPUs)
entries.detail: the D2H poll loop is cheap at the observed cadence; a finer sweep is still available via watch

entries.title: direct D2H reader poll rate (live counter delta)
entries.method: documented: 21,288 rd_status polls over ~147 s of AP operation
entries.detail: configured cadence is 5 ms (200/s); the observed ~145/s includes service-pass work; 0 overruns, 64 frames

entries.title: direct D2H frames decoded during the live sample
entries.method: documented: live rd_status/rd_catalog delta over ~147 s
entries.detail: 0 overruns; d2h words=43, dropped=0

entries.title: g4 id4 heartbeat interval (live, 10 samples)
entries.method: documented: live 10-sample measurement during AP operation
entries.detail: 1.009-1.011 s, jitter < 1 ms (the dmesg-recorded 1000 ms median in this baseline is print-timestamp granularity)

entries.title: hi5622_wifi module memory in /proc/modules (live)
entries.method: documented: live /proc/modules sample during AP operation
entries.detail: image module is stripped 231,132 B on disk; 184,320 B resident code+data accounting

entries.title: cfg80211 module memory in /proc/modules (live)
entries.method: documented: live /proc/modules sample

entries.title: MemTotal during AP operation (live)
entries.method: documented: live /proc/meminfo sample
entries.detail: 66,784 kB free

entries.title: MemFree during AP operation (live)
entries.method: documented: live /proc/meminfo sample

entries.title: CPU release -> READY handshake (live tuning-phase sample)
entries.method: documented: live tuning-phase measurement (approximate)
entries.detail: consistent with the dmesg-recorded 1120 ms release->ready-pair (n=11, grade V*)

entries.title: insmod -> usable iface (live tuning-phase sample)
entries.method: documented: live tuning-phase measurement (approximate)
entries.detail: includes the boot ladder + cfg80211 registration; the dmesg-observed ladder is 4.03 s to READY and the phase timer is 6.1 s including deploy

entries.title: 13-channel scan: time for the first 6 channel results (live)
entries.method: documented: live tuning-phase measurement (ch1..ch6 in 0.94 s)
entries.detail: ~156 ms/channel, consistent with the 82-320 ms per-channel gaps in the recorded dmesg

entries.title: 13-channel scan: early per-channel cost (live, 6 channels)
entries.method: documented: 940 ms / 6 channels
entries.detail: contradicts the earlier 830 ms/ch and 3.5 s/ch estimates; the firmware is fast for 6 channels and then stops

entries.title: 13-channel scan: channels processed before the firmware hard-stops
entries.method: documented: live tuning-phase measurement + every recorded 13-channel fire
entries.source: ledger 2026-11-27 20:30; this baseline's UART/dmesg records (6/13 fires)
entries.detail: no results for the remaining 14 s; hypotheses: wrong channel-count field (+0x1EC), truncated channel array, firmware caps 6 per request (needs pagination) or a cursor field
